git_closeout_policy.description: Reconciled 2026-08-18 (pre-authorized OPS-20260818-SELECTOR-PREAUTHORIZATION-INSTALL-001) to the Conductor/GitCloseoutGate runtime accepted set. Values bounded_local_commit_authorized / bounded_local_commit_authorized_no_push are historical ticket-text artifacts and are NOT legal selector values; unknown values REFUSE (never silent default).

push_authorized.description: Derived from git_closeout_policy: report_only/defer_until_product_boundary/commit_if_authorized -> false; push_if_authorized/enforce_clean_sync -> true. Explicit contradiction refuses (PUSH_POLICY_CONTRADICTION).

classification.description: Envelope class; class contracts in RCD_SELECTOR_MANIFEST_v1 constrain required/forbidden fields and legal status/authority_effect per class.

status.description: Class-dependent status; legal values per classification are defined in RCD_SELECTOR_MANIFEST_v1 selectors.status.class_dependent.

execution_lane.description: Execution lane family; historical lane names (e.g. copilot_deepseek_v4_flash) are NOT legal selector values.

delivery_mode.description: Matches the Conductor CdpDeliveryMode runtime allowed set.

routing_mode.description: Routing mode; authority is the canonical default.

selector_manifest_version.description: Selector-era envelope stamp: the selector manifest version used to author this envelope. Required for new envelopes; absence is NOT legacy by itself (positive legacy_provenance required for legacy qualification).

legacy_provenance.description: Positive legacy qualification: explicit source of provenance. Envelopes without selector_manifest_version qualify as legacy ONLY when this object is present and source_path exists.
